I need to identify the live event mechanism, locate the hub implementation, and find the memo handlers that broadcast through it.

SSEHub appears in prior search results. I am locating its exact implementation and related handler files.
Checking memo_update_helpers to identify the broadcasting handler. Reading sse_handler.go to confirm the SSE mechanism.

Tracing which handlers call `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` to identify the memo handlers broadcasting live events.

Also checking whether `SetMemoAttachments` or other memo handlers broadcast live events.

The focus is on identifying the memo handlers that broadcast through the hub.

Memo handlers that broadcast through the hub include CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, UpdateMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations. UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction are also included.

Checking whether CreateMemo broadcasts SSE events when attachments are set. The sse_service_test mentions CreateMemoWithAttachment.

CreateMemo broadcasts directly. SetMemoAttachments and SetMemoRelations broadcast via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects. UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction broadcast as MemoService RPCs. All eight handlers are included. SSE is the mechanism. The hub is implemented in server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go.

The final answer uses the exact format requested. The SSE hub path is server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. The handler names are CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction.

The mechanism is Server-Sent Events (SSE).

The hub is implemented in sse_hub.go. Direct memo handlers are CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, and CreateMemoComment. Handlers that broadcast via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects are UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations. Reaction handlers are UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction. All are APIV1Service methods.

q20. SSE (Server-Sent Events); server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction

Browsers connect to `/api/v1/sse` for live updates. The handler in `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` sets `Content-Type: text/event-stream` and streams events from the hub:

```46:48:server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go
	// Set SSE headers.
	w := c.Response()
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
```

The hub is `SSEHub` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`, created in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` and registered via `RegisterSSERoutes`.
